integrity: The seven-step proof establishes the infinite-parameter classification; 4096 independent set comparisons, maxima checks over 18 lengths and bivariate checks through length 17 are finite corroboration only. The scientific claims are not independently audited or certified.
limitations: All exact theorems apply only to binary linear words with exactly four positive constant runs and contiguous minimal absent factors. They do not assert general-runs, larger-alphabet or scattered-subsequence statements. The full text of a potentially relevant 2024 algorithmic source was inaccessible; publication priority is not guaranteed.
title: Four-run binary antidictionaries: an exact classification and generating spectrum
